secrets.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: A fake GitHub token on an added diff line is caught; the line is reported, the value is not.

changed.description: One byte: the token prefix ghp_ becomes ghq_ (no longer a token format).

cases.purpose: The whole diff text is scanned: a fake AWS key id on an unchanged context line still invalidates the run.

changed.description: One byte: the key id's last character E becomes '-', leaving 15 key characters.

cases.purpose: A ledger row is scanned after JSON decoding: a key id whose F is written as the JSON unicode escape backslash-u0046 is caught on its row (the raw line holds no key id).

changed.description: One byte: the escape backslash-u0046 (F) becomes backslash-u0026 (&), so the decoded text is no key id.

cases.purpose: A fake token inside an outgoing prompt is caught (the run is invalid and the prompt must not be sent).

changed.description: One byte: ghp_ becomes ghp- in the prompt.

cases.purpose: A clean prompt passes (clean true): a scanner that never lets a prompt through is caught.

changed.description: One byte: ghp- becomes ghp_ (the prompt of secrets.prompt).

cases.purpose: Tokens glued to a word by '_' (x_ghp_..., x_AKIA...) are caught: the pilot's cycle-4 refutation of a word-boundary scanner (docs/pilot-gunlugu.md:26) is inside the floor.

changed.description: One byte: x_ghp_ becomes x_ghq_ (the AWS line still matches).

cases.purpose: Clean input passes: near-miss strings (ghq_ prefix, 15-character key id) and the word FAKE are not matches.

changed.description: One byte: ghq_ becomes ghp_, turning the near miss into a token format.

cases.purpose: A row that does not decode cannot be declared clean: unusable input fails closed (clean false, exit 2).

changed.description: One byte: the missing closing brace is added; the row decodes and holds no secret.

contained.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: The argv for a valid request carries --network none, --cap-drop ALL, --read-only, --user <uid>, the memory limit read from operating.container_mem_bytes.value, only the worktree and outdir writable, the artefact read-only, exactly the request's env, and the digest-pinned image.

changed.description: One byte: operating.container_mem_bytes.value 536870912 -> 536870913.

cases.purpose: A second, different request (other image, uid, memory, no artefacts) gives its own projection; a fixed argv cannot satisfy both.

changed.description: One field: uid 2002 -> 2003.

cases.purpose: An image referenced by tag, not @sha256, is refused.

changed.description: One field: image is the digest-pinned reference.

cases.purpose: A request that would pass an ACTIONS_* variable into the container is refused, not silently stripped.

changed.description: One field: the variable name ACTIONS_CACHE_URL becomes SNOWBALL_CACHE_URL.

cases.purpose: A request that would mount the docker socket is refused.

changed.description: One field: artefacts is the ordinary deps directory.

cases.purpose: Stage 0 units are service-less: a request naming a service (which would need a network) is refused.

changed.description: One field: services is empty.

cases.purpose: No constant limits: without operating.container_mem_bytes the request is refused.

changed.description: One field: operating carries container_mem_bytes again.

profile.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: Agent configuration is excluded at any depth and in any letter case (.Claude/ at the root, Claude.md inside a unit).

changed.description: One byte in a tree member name: .Claude/settings.json becomes .Clauda/settings.json.

cases.purpose: The operator's excluded_paths (operator.json, from targets[]) exclude vendor/: its .py file adds no language and the vendor candidate is dropped.

changed.description: One field: excluded_paths is empty (operator_no_excluded.json).

cases.purpose: Security paths follow the keyword rule over path and file names (auth/ directory, session.ts, tokenizer.js by substring).

changed.description: One byte in a tree member name: session.ts becomes sessian.ts.

cases.purpose: Unit candidates keep the operator's order and drop the missing one (packages/missing), the agent-configuration one (.Claude, which has a file under it) and the excluded one (vendor).

changed.description: One field: unit_candidates lists packages/api before packages/web (operator_reordered.json).

cases.purpose: A proposal equal to the derivation except that it drops the case-variant agent file packages/api/Claude.md from excluded_paths narrows the list and is rejected.

changed.description: One field: the proposal's excluded_paths holds packages/api/Claude.md again (proposal equals the derivation).

cases.purpose: A proposal whose languages differ from the derivation (adds python) is rejected.

changed.description: One field: languages equals the derivation (proposal equals the derivation).

npmlock.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: Every tarball matches the lock's sha512 integrity; b's install script is marked in the recipe list; the content address and the license report (read from each tarball) are produced.

changed.description: One byte in tarball a (gzip header OS byte 255 -> 3; the tar inside is byte-identical) via a second mirror.

cases.purpose: Package b's tarball declares a postinstall script (the lock does not say hasInstallScript); unmarked in install_scripts_required it is rejected.

changed.description: One field: install_scripts_required names snowball-fixture-b@2.0.0.

cases.purpose: A resolved URL on registry.npmjs.org.evil.example is not the allowed https://registry.npmjs.org/ (a host-prefix lookalike), so it is rejected before any fetch.

changed.description: One field: resolved is the allowed registry URL (lock_only_a.json).

cases.purpose: A git dependency (git+ssh resolved) is rejected even though it carries an integrity value.

changed.description: One field: resolved is the registry URL of the same tarball (lock_only_a.json).

cases.purpose: A file: dependency is rejected even though it carries an integrity value.

changed.description: One field: resolved is the registry URL of the same tarball (lock_only_a.json).

cases.purpose: The license report reads the tarball's package.json (GPL-3.0-only), not the lock's license field (MIT); a target dependency's license is reported, not gated, so the fetch still succeeds.

changed.description: One field: the tarball's license is MIT (lock integrity follows the tarball; lock license field unchanged).

cases.purpose: The same lock re-serialised (compact, keys reordered) gives the same content address as lock_good.json.

changed.description: One field: package b is removed (lock_only_a.json).

recipe.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: A complete Stage 0 recipe passes the static check.

changed.description: One field: services names a database image.

cases.purpose: An env_image referenced by tag, without @sha256, is rejected.

changed.description: One field: env_image is the digest-pinned reference.

cases.purpose: A digest of 63 hex characters is not a pinned image.

changed.description: One byte: the 64th hex character is restored.

cases.purpose: inputs must contain the unit's own directory (path); packages/apx/ does not cover packages/api.

changed.description: One byte: packages/apx/ becomes packages/api/.

cases.purpose: An inputs entry that is agent configuration in any letter case (packages/api/.Claude/) is rejected.

changed.description: One byte: .Claude/ becomes .Clauda/.

cases.purpose: An absolute inputs entry (/packages/shared/) is not a plain repository path and is rejected.

changed.description: One byte: the leading slash is removed.

cases.purpose: Every limits key must be an operating{} key; cpu_seconds is not.

changed.description: One field: the key cpu_seconds becomes test_total_s.

cases.purpose: test_cmd must be a non-empty argv list.

changed.description: One field: test_cmd is npm test --workspace packages/api.

cases.purpose: The other two commands are checked too: lint_cmd holding an empty string and a missing affected_test_cmd each give their own reason (a check of test_cmd alone is caught).

changed.description: One field: lint_cmd is npx eslint packages/api/src (affected_test_cmd is still missing).

diffguard.source: reconciled cases; every expected value given alike by two blind independent implementations (docs/eksik-kaydi.md E161)

cases.purpose: A plain edit inside the unit's inputs (packages/shared/) passes.

changed.description: One byte in the path: packages/shared/ becomes packages/sharex/ (outside inputs).

cases.purpose: A new symbolic link (git mode 120000) inside the inputs is rejected.

changed.description: One field: the mode is 100644 (a regular file with the same text).

cases.purpose: A new submodule (git mode 160000) inside the inputs is rejected.

changed.description: One field: the mode is 100644 (a regular file with the same text).

cases.purpose: A path with a ../ component is rejected even though it normalises back inside the unit.

changed.description: One byte in the path: the .. component becomes .x.

cases.purpose: Agent configuration is rejected in any letter case (Claude.md inside the unit).

changed.description: One byte in the path: Claude.md becomes Claude.mb.

cases.purpose: A path under the profile's security_paths (packages/api/src/vault/, no keyword in it) is rejected.

changed.description: One byte in the path: vault/ becomes vaulx/.

cases.purpose: Edits to a manifest (package.json), a lockfile (package-lock.json), a lint config (.eslintrc.json) and .gitattributes inside the inputs are each rejected with their own reason.

changed.description: One byte in one path: .gitattributes becomes .gitattributez.

cases.purpose: A path under the profile's excluded_dirs (the operator's excluded path packages/api/generated/) is rejected.

changed.description: One byte in the path: generated/ becomes generatex/.

cases.purpose: Every applicable reason of a path is reported, not only the first: a manifest outside the inputs gives both manifest and outside_inputs.

changed.description: One byte in the path: packages/sharex/ becomes packages/shared/ (inside the inputs; only manifest remains).
